Can you deliver high‑quality technical service on cutting‑edge radar systems?

At Weibel you will join a truly international and technology-driven company that develops excellent radars for both the defense and civil industry across the world. Our advanced technology and ambitious strategy have secured us success in the market and continuous growth.

As part of this growth, we are looking for a skilled Field Service Engineer to join our expanding team.

Your role

As Field Service Engineer in the Surveillance team you will work with our XENTA radar system, developed for Short Range Air Defense (SHORAD) and C-UAS applications. XENTA is a state-of-the-art radar system designed for high-performance 3D air surveillance of all types of air threats.

Our team’s mission is to keep our global customers satisfied. You will play a central role in this, supporting the full lifecycle from installation to operation and maintenance – both at our headquarters in Allerød and at customer sites worldwide.

Your primary tasks include:

• Pre FAT / SAT system testing and Customer FAT / SAT testing

• Installation, integration, and acceptance testing of Weibel radar systems

• Customer support and incident handling

• On‑site mission support

• Execution of preventive maintenance programs and upgrades

• System performance and maintenance documentation

• Root cause analysis and recommendations for corrective actions

• Training of customer personnel in system operation and maintenance

We offer continuous training, and your responsibilities will increase as your expertise grows.

The role includes up to 75 yearly travel days, sometimes on short notice. You must be able to travel freely within the EU and enter the USA under an ESTA permit or equivalent.

Your Profile

We are looking for a service‑minded technical professional who enjoys taking ownership and thrives in dynamic, real‑world environments. To succeed in this role, you combine solid technical skills with a proactive and structured mindset.

Your experience and competences:

• A formal technical education with a strong understanding of IT systems, electronics, and mechanical principles

• Practical hands‑on experience with electronics, tools, and test equipment

• Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics

• Basic knowledge of multi‑pin connectors and their repair

• Strong communication skills in written and spoken English

If you also are familiar with industry practices, it will be an advantage, but not a requirement for this role.

Your approach:

• You take initiative and work effectively both independently and in collaboration with others

• You plan and prioritize your tasks with care, even when conditions change

• You maintain an open mindset and communicate confidently with people from diverse cultures and professional backgrounds

• You approach customers with professionalism, patience, and a strong sense of responsibility

• You thrive working in the field with hands-on tasks, both independently and with customers

Contact and Application

Please apply via our website using the “Apply” button. Applications are welcome in Danish or English.

If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact our Team Lead Aftermarket Surveillance, Thim Kristensen, at thk@weibel.dk

The deadline is October 25th, 2026.

Please be aware that it is a requirement for this position that you can provide a criminal record with no remarks and obtain a security clearance.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Become part of a Danish company

Weibel Scientific A/S is a Danish-owned engineering company experiencing strong growth. We develop and manufacture high‑technology radar systems for use in areas such as space research, aviation, defense, and the protection of critical infrastructure. We are a world leader in the development of Doppler radars and, since our establishment in 1977, we have delivered more than 4,500 state‑of-the-art radar systems to over 40 countries.

Our headquarters are located in Allerød and employ nearly 600 people.

At Weibel, you can look forward to an exciting and challenging position in a dynamic and forward‑looking company with in-house production and advanced technological development.

Read more about us on our website.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager Global Rewards - Exec. Rem.
jobs.description:
We are looking for an analytical profile with in-depth Rewards experience to join our Global Rewards & People Analytics team.

About the team

Our team brings together expertise across Global Rewards, Mobility, People Analytics, People Technology & Data, and Danish Payroll & Benefits.

In Rewards, we are responsible for the design, governance and continuous development of our global reward programmes and frameworks. You will be a key partner to the Senior Director Global Rewards & People Analytics on Executive Rewards, supporting analyses, market insights, presentations, remuneration governance and the development of future reward solutions.

“We are an ambitious and engaged team focused on developing solutions that are relevant, engaging and aligned with business needs, while ensuring successful implementation across the organisation”, says Wandunia Pontoppidan, Senior Director, Global Rewards.

The job

You will build a strong network across the organisation and work closely with colleagues across functions and countries from specialists to people partners and senior leaders.

In preparation for our Remuneration Committee meetings, you will partner closely with Senior Director, Global Rewards & People Analytics on executive remuneration and the ongoing evolution of our variable pay programmes. You will analyse current practices, assess market trends and alternative approaches, and develop recommendations that help ensure our reward programmes remain competitive, effective and aligned with our strategic priorities.

In close collaboration with Reward colleagues, people partners and business leaders, you will be responsible for:

•    Supporting Remuneration Committee activities, including benchmarking, analytics, presentation materials and recommendations related to executive remuneration.

•    Supporting annual Executive Leadership Team reward reviews and reporting activities.

•    Reviewing and designing short and long-term incentive programmes, including implementation planning and change communications.

•    Partnering with leaders and people partners on position evaluations and salary recommendations for new hires and promotions at ‘Director’ level and above.

•    Conducting organisational and remuneration reviews and contributing to projects that strengthen our reward offerings across geographies.

•    Contributing to country benchmarking and annual salary review activities, including salary range development and budgeting during peak periods.

You will work with senior stakeholders and translate complex information into clear decision-making material. You will challenge the status quo and balance thorough analysis with pragmatic solutions. Drawing on data, market insights and external trends, you will help shape reward solutions that support both business priorities and the employee experience.

What you bring

We are looking for someone who can build credibility and influence through strong relationships, sound judgement and thoughtful communication. You are confident in your expertise, while remaining curious, open to feedback and keen to learn from others. You are ambitious and always strive for great results together with your team and colleagues, and you know how to balance high quality with timely deliveries.

You understand the critical link between reward design, people data and technology. You are comfortable working with people data structures, governance and system implications, ensuring that reward frameworks can be translated into practical, compliant and efficient solutions across platforms.

Given the nature of the role, you handle sensitive information with discretion and sound judgement, and confidentiality is a natural part of how you work.

Qualifications and personality

We expect that you:

•    Hold a relevant Masters’ degree

•    Have +5 years of experience working in Rewards in a global context.

•    Have experience working with executive remuneration and various long-term incentive instruments.

•    Possess strong stakeholder relations and collaboration skills

•    Have a curious and analytical mindset, and the ability to comprehend complex data sets.

•    Can convert data into findings and recommendations through simple and appealing visuals.

•    Are structured, organised and have a strong eye for detail

•    Are strong in Excel and PowerPoint and can apply AI

•    Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing

We offer

This position offers a global perspective, with collaboration across our 42 countries.  You will gain exposure to the full Rewards agenda, with a particular focus on Executive Remuneration and short and long-term incentive programmes. The role combines analytical depth with stakeholder engagement, translating complex data into insights and decision materials for senior stakeholders.

Our culture is one of trust, fun and creativity, with a strong focus on quality, compliance and process optimization. We are part of the People & Culture organization and work out of our HQ in Denmark.

Need more Information?

If you have additional questions, please contact Wandunia Pontoppidan, Senior Director Global Rewards & People Analytics, dkwapo@coloplast.com

Shape the Creative Expression of Pandora Stores Worldwide

We are looking for a highly creative and strategic leader to join Pandora's Store Creative & Design team as Senior Manager, Store Communications Creative.

In this role, you will lead the creative development and execution of global store communications, bringing our campaigns, products, and brand stories to life across retail environments worldwide. You will define visual identities, creative concepts, graphic systems, and storytelling approaches that create inspiring and memorable customer experiences while ensuring consistency across markets.

Combining hands-on creative direction with leadership of a multidisciplinary team, you will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders and external creative partners to deliver distinctive, culturally relevant, and scalable retail communications across customer-facing in-store touchpoints.

What You'll Do

Lead Creative Concept Development

• Develop creative territories, campaign concepts, and storytelling approaches for global store communications.

• Translate brand and product strategies into compelling retail experiences that strengthen customer engagement and brand recognition.

• Drive ideation and creative exploration from concept through execution.

• Use consumer, cultural, and retail insights to inform creative concepts and ensure relevance across markets.

Define Visual Identity & Art Direction

• Provide hands-on art direction throughout the creative process, from moodboards and prototypes to final production.

• Lead creative reviews and provide clear, constructive feedback that elevates the quality of ideas and execution.

• Ensure a consistently high standard of craft and execution across all customer-facing communications.

Drive Global Retail Communication Excellence

• Lead the development of printed communications, graphic assets, and in-store storytelling materials.

• Create scalable frameworks, templates, and guidelines that enable effective global-to-local execution.

• Oversee production quality and creative standards across printed communications and in-store assets.

• Balance global brand consistency with local market relevance.

Collaborate Across Teams & Partners

• Brief and manage external creative talent, including designers, photographers, illustrators, filmmakers, copywriters, and agencies.

• Build strong creative partnerships that bring fresh ideas and perspectives into the work.

Lead, Mentor & Inspire

• Lead and develop a team of creative professionals through coaching, feedback, and creative mentorship.

• Foster a culture of experimentation, collaboration, and creative excellence.

• Champion new ideas, emerging trends, and innovative approaches to retail communication.

What You'll Bring

• Strong portfolio demonstrating concept-led campaigns, visual identity systems, and exceptional creative execution.

• Ability to translate business and brand strategies into compelling customer-facing creative concepts.

• Strong understanding of graphic design, typography, visual storytelling, print communication, and retail creative execution.

• Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

• Experience working within retail, fashion, lifestyle, luxury, or consumer-facing brands is strongly preferred.

Additional Information

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Department: Store Creative & Design

Reports to: Director, Store Creative

People Leadership: 5 direct reports

Why Join Pandora?

At Pandora, you'll have the opportunity to shape how millions of customers experience our brand in stores around the world. You'll work alongside talented creatives, influence global campaigns, and help define the future of retail storytelling for the world's largest jewellery brand.

If you're passionate about concept-driven creativity, visual storytelling, and leading teams to do their very best work, we'd love to hear from you.

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

We're looking to expand our Aarhus team with a Senior Data and AI Advisor who can help clients bridge that gap: shaping data strategies, designing modern data platforms, and establishing the data management practices that turn AI from ambition into impact.

As a senior member of our team, you'll be working in the sweet spot where strategy meets execution and help our clients get their data, architecture, and organisation ready for value-creating AI use cases.

Specifically, you will:

• Shape data and AI strategies with senior stakeholders, translating business ambitions into actionable roadmaps

• Design modern data platforms and target architectures that enable analytics and AI at scale

• Establish data management and governance practices – ownership, quality, and ways of working that make data a trusted asset

• Drive project delivery from strategy to implementation, ensuring meaningful and lasting client impact

We're looking for a seasoned advisor who combines structured thinking, technical depth, and a collaborative mindset. In the best-case scenario, you bring:

• A relevant master's degree (e.g., in Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or Business)

Our Data & AI team has seen substantial growth over the past few years, driven by strong demand for both technical builders and advisors who can connect data foundations to real AI value – and by our ability to combine subject-matter expertise with effective change management.

Joining us means entering a world of:

• A flat organisation where your ideas and initiatives matter from day one

Implement supports organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. The company combines analytical rigour, functional expertise, and industry insight with a unique collaborative model and an ability to engage and mobilise client organisations.

Ready to drive change with data and shape the future of AI?

Make your next move matter.

Apply now.

This maternity cover is based in our skilled Nutrition Research Team in Nutrition & Health at Arla Innovation Centre in Aarhus N. You will work closely with colleagues across Arla and build a broad network across research, innovation, public affairs and other science teams.

“You will join Nutrition & Health, where we drive Arla Foods’ health agenda through research, scientific insight and innovation support. We are 11 colleagues, most with PhDs, who are passionate about helping consumers live healthier lives. We value open discussions, collaboration and using each other’s strengths to succeed as a team,” says Head of Nutrition & Health, Anne Louise Mørkbak.

About the job

In this maternity cover, you will help set the scientific direction for selected nutrition research areas and translate research into opportunities for innovation, communication and stakeholder engagement. You will be responsible for the research areas Dairy Matrix and Healthy, Sustainable Diets, and you will help turn scientific knowledge into relevant business opportunities for Arla. You will work closely with Public Affairs and nutrition experts to strengthen Arla’s work on the role of dairy in sustainable, healthy diets, food security.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Keeping up to date with the latest science in your research areas.

• Developing, evaluating and maturing new research ideas that support the goals of the research areas.

• Preparing clear, high-quality project proposals for review in Arla’s research and portfolio governance forums.

• Managing ongoing research projects within your areas of responsibility.

• Providing scientific and strategic input to new project ideas.

• Identifying risks, resource needs and practical solutions to keep projects on track.

• Working across functions to ensure scientific insights are translated into relevant business opportunities.

Who are you?

You are a scientifically strong and curious person who enjoys turning complex nutrition science into clear recommendations and business-relevant opportunities. You think holistically, understand how science can support innovation and communication, and are comfortable collaborating with colleagues outside your own area of expertise.

You will help shape the direction of your research areas, so we are looking for someone who is proactive, structured and confident in sharing ideas and perspectives.

Further, we imagine that you

• Have an MSc and PhD in nutrition with research experience within Dairy Matrix and/or Sustainable Healthy Diets.

• Commercial experience a plus.

• Communicate fluently in English.

What do we offer?

We offer a collaborative and professional environment where you can develop your expertise, take responsibility for your own areas and contribute to meaningful work in nutrition and health. You will join a global dairy company with well-known brands and a strong focus on nutritious products, consumers and our farmer owners.

You will gain insight into the dairy industry from the inside, work with dedicated colleagues and have the flexibility needed to solve your tasks. You can also expect open discussions, constructive feedback and opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.

Application and contact

If you would like to contribute to nutrition and health research at Arla and help translate science into impact, we would like to hear from you.

If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

• Build features across AccuRanker and AccuLLM: Django APIs, background jobs, and the data models behind them.

• Design ClickHouse schemas and query paths, and keep the 64 million daily analytical queries fast as the data grows.
